title: Extra-Person Charges on Room Reservations with Added Adults
content:
## Desk guidance

A reservation whose adults were raised in the mobile app or on the brand website keeps the double-occupancy nightly rate of its room type until guest services adds the extra-person charge for the adults beyond those the plan's rate covers; the charge is added only on a confirmed reservation not booked through an online travel agency, and only the nightly rate changes. The guidance concerns Room Reservations reservations.

The extra-person charge is added to the nightly rate only after the room type on the reservation sleeps every adult registered on it.

| Condition for adding the charge | Shown by |
|---|---|
| The reservation's status is confirmed | the reservation record |
| It was not booked through an online travel agency | the booking channel on the reservation record |
| The room type on the reservation sleeps every adult registered on it | the room type and adults on the reservation record |

Put the other way round, while the room type on the reservation does not sleep every adult registered on it, the extra-person charge is not added to the nightly rate.

**Business effect.** Only the nightly room rate before tax changes; the adults, room type, dates and guarantee stay as they are, and the guest sees the new nightly rate on the reservation at once.

## Recording the charge: `reprice_extra_persons_22837316`

**Capability.** The tool records the nightly room rate of one room reservation once the extra-person charge for its registered adults has been priced in.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: guest services unlocks `reprice_extra_persons_22837316` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `reservation_id` — reference number of the room reservation being re-priced, as returned by the reservation lookup for the guest's confirmation number (identifier).
- `nightly_rate` — nightly room rate before tax including the extra-person charge, in USD, with 2 decimal places, written as a plain number such as 123.45; it is stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with the keys `reservation_id` (the reservation re-priced), `nightly_rate` (the nightly rate now on the reservation, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, the literal "repriced", which shows the new rate was recorded.

## Questions on the guidance

**The guest added a third adult in the app. Has the rate already changed?** No. The reservation keeps the double-occupancy nightly rate of its room type until guest services adds the extra-person charge.

**Does adding the charge change the room type or the adults?** No; only the nightly rate changes.

**A reservation booked through an online travel agency shows an added adult.** Guest services does not add the charge; it is added only on reservations not booked through an online travel agency.
